newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Baby girl's mother killed in Tel Aviv bombing.
newsitem.headline: Baby girl's mother killed in Tel Aviv bombing.

text.p: Israeli authorities confirmed a nation's fears on Saturday -- the baby girl wounded in the Tel Aviv cafe suicide bombing lost her mother in the blast.
Anat Rosen-Vinter, 31, the infant's mother, was identified officially as one of the three women killed on Friday by a Moslem suicide bomber during the Jewish holiday of Purim.

Television pictures broadcast around the world showed an Israeli policewoman cradling the baby, dressed in a tattered clown costume, and looking frantically for the parents. The infant was taken to hospital and was expected to recover.
"I saw her mother," medic Pinni Melech told Israel Radio on Friday. "Her whole face was burned, without an ear and a mess."
It took coroners an entire day to make the identification.
In an ironic footnote to the attack, the father of another woman killed in the explosion said she had been a social worker who comforted families of victims of Moslem suicide bombings last year.

"Whenever casualties were taken to Beilinson hospital (near Tel Aviv), she would be called in. Regretfully, yesterday we saw for ourselves the hard work these social workers do -- sacred work -- when they tried to comfort us," said the father of Michal Avrahami, 32.
